competency.title: Reproduce planning — worked example
competency.outcome: Reproduce a stated result for planning using a dependency-aware action plan. Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.

topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: following a stale plan after new evidence

competency.practice_task: Produce a rerun manifest with data, version, seeds and commands grounded in a dependency-aware action plan.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.
required_evidence: a rerun manifest with data, version, seeds and commands
Include the solved case and the changed-case prediction.
Report goal completion, cost and replans with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: following a stale plan after new evidence.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of planning.
Practice: the rerun agrees within a predeclared tolerance.
Measurement: report goal completion, cost and replans against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for following a stale plan after new evidence; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
